The preview runs the existing Svelte UI example JSON unchanged through the `@viewstem/ui` DOM renderer. Try input changes, event Actions, and State updates. **Run in your app** includes the complete setup for this example.

## Registration and rendering

```ts
import { createRegistry, createRuntime } from "@viewstem/core";
import { registerShadcn, attach } from "@viewstem/ui";
import "@viewstem/ui/styles.css";

const registry = createRegistry();
registerShadcn(registry);
const runtime = createRuntime({ registry });
```

`registerShadcn` registers all 66 families. See the [browser mount guide](../../guides/mount-in-browser/) for View creation and disposal, or open the matching [Svelte UI reference](../../../svelte-ui/components/data-table/).

## JSON components

These tables describe inputs, slots, and events from `@viewstem/ui/support.json`. Omitted inputs use renderer defaults. Events deliver JSON payloads matching these schemas rather than DOM Event objects. Svelte native exports and context-only parts are outside this package API.

### `shadcn.DataTable`

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `Array<{ id: string, accessorKey: string, label: string, sortable?: boolean, filterable?: boolean }>` | `[]` no extra fields |
| `data` | `Array<object>` |  |
| `filter` | `string` |  |
| `labels` | `{ filter?: string, select?: string, selectRow?: string, noRows?: string, previous?: string, next?: string, page?: string, rowsPerPage?: string }` | no extra fields |
| `pageIndex` | `integer` | minimum 0 |
| `pageSize` | `integer` | minimum 1 |
| `rowId` | `string` |  |
| `selectedIds` | `Array<string>` |  |
| `sorting` | `Array<{ id: string, desc: boolean }>` | `[]` no extra fields |

**Slots**

None.

**Events and payloads**

| Events | JSON payload | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sortingChange` | `{ value: Array<{ id: string, desc: boolean }> }` | no extra fields · `value[]` no extra fields |
| `pageIndexChange`, `pageSizeChange` | `{ value: number }` | no extra fields |
| `filterChange` | `{ value: string }` | no extra fields |
| `selectedIdsChange` | `{ value: Array<string> }` | no extra fields |
